notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/alrhub__d3il --backend fake (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware backend exists and no hardware was run. The upstream clone needs MuJoCo 2.1 binaries, a C compiler, gym, numpy and cv2 (card install.system_deps) and was never imported or run, so the fake backend is the package's own pure Python kinematic sorting stand-in (fake.py) and was not compared with the upstream environment; the sim backend (gym.make('sorting-v0', render=False)) was not run. The fake returns the full declared 8-value observation of the num_boxes=2 environment (no array is reduced). The 2-D action is treated as an end-effector displacement; the upstream wrapper passes it to CartPosQuatImpedenceController.setSetPoint, which reads a 7-value pose, so the fake does not reproduce that controller path (listed in the fidelity gaps). Four warnings are expected of a Gymnasium family driver: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the generator of the next reset) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the integer inputs and action values the bridge derives (seed twice, ticks, action.values). There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Only catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the last check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
